summary: Reared on a puppy farm, and abandoned by a previous owner, he was half-starved when we adopted him. summary: Despite it being a complex operation, ERMIS-3, an 8U CubeSat developed by the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens, has established a link with an optical ground station marking an important step in validating optical communications on small satellites.
